tagline: A community bank alternative to super-regional financial institutions serving the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area
hero_kpi_rationale: Total assets of $10.5 billion reflect Eagle Bancorp's size and positioning as an independent community bank in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area, serving as the primary indicator of balance sheet capacity and market exposure.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets held by the bank, such as loans and investments.
kpis.description: Total assets reflect the size of the balance sheet and market exposure. They include primarily loans and securities.
kpis.signal: $10.5 billion in total assets at end-2025.

kpis.name: Loans Held for Investment
kpis.explanation: Total amount of loans the bank holds in its portfolio.
kpis.description: Loans are the primary source of interest income. The portfolio is concentrated in commercial real estate and local businesses.
kpis.signal: $7.3 billion in loans held at end-2025.

kpis.name: Total Deposits
kpis.explanation: Total amount of customer deposits, the bank's primary funding source.
kpis.description: Deposits fund loans and investments. A stable deposit base is an advantage during periods of volatility.

kpis.name: Local Market Unemployment Rate (Washington, D.C.)
kpis.explanation: Unemployment rate in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area, where the bank primarily operates.
kpis.description: Higher unemployment may increase loan default risk, especially in sensitive sectors such as hospitality and services.
kpis.signal: Local unemployment rate rising to 4.4% at end-2025.

kpis.name: U.S. GDP Growth
kpis.explanation: Annual economic growth of the United States, which influences credit demand.
kpis.description: Slower growth may reduce local economic activity and loan demand.
kpis.signal: GDP growth at 2.2% in 2025, down from 2024.

kpis.name: 10-Year U.S. Treasury Rate
kpis.explanation: Benchmark interest rate that directly influences the bank's net interest margins.
kpis.description: Higher rates may improve margins if loans are fixed-rate, but also increase funding costs.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.11 Bn€ in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of 0.7 Bn€ in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets held by the bank.
kpis.description: Balance sheet size reflects the bank's position in its local market.
kpis.signal: $10.5 billion in total assets at end-2025.

kpis.name: U.S. GDP Growth
kpis.explanation: Annual economic growth of the United States.
kpis.description: Economic growth directly influences the health of the loan portfolio.

risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to reputation risks, which may impact its ability to attract and retain customers. Negative events may have a significant impact on the company's reputation.
